page.overview:
What is Basu Basu no Mi?

The Basu Basu no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn anything they touch into a bomb, making them a . It was eaten by Balzac.

The main strength of this Devil Fruit is that it allows the user to turn anything they touch into a bomb.

Aside from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses, there seems to be no known weaknesses to this power.
